group-2025-ii-seven-choices.overview: 本篇为说明文，主题是“以家庭为单位做志愿服务的意外好处”。文章用一个引入段加四个带小标题（bullet）的分述段，分别从“感觉时间更多”“更长寿/身体健康”“对孩子和青少年的终身影响”“与家人共度更多时光”四个角度展开，结构清晰，属于典型的“总—分”小标题式七选五。

discourseStructure.summary: 引入段抛出问题并点明志愿服务对全家有意外好处；随后四个小标题段各自先用一句概括性主题句（多为待填空的标题句），再用研究或细节展开。空格主要落在小标题主题句或承接句上，靠话题场对齐与上下文呼应来确定。

units.heading: Unexpected Benefits of Volunteering as a Family
units.summary: 引入段：以两个问句吸引读者，提出“家庭志愿服务可能正是你需要的”，并预告下文会讲意外好处。第36空在此段。

units.heading: You’ll feel like you have more time.
units.summary: 小标题段一：研究表明付出时间反而让人觉得时间更充裕。第37空在段末，承接“感觉时间更多”这一收益。

units.heading: You can live longer if you volunteer regularly.
units.summary: 小标题段二：用华盛顿大学对55岁以上成年人的研究说明志愿者记忆更好、更注重身体活动。第38空为该段主题句。

units.heading: (blank heading)
units.summary: 小标题段三：青少年期做志愿与成绩提升、自信增强等长期正面效果相关。第39空为该段缺失的小标题。

units.heading: You’ll have more time with family.
units.summary: 小标题段四：全家共同志愿能朝共同目标努力、彼此以新方式联结。第40空承接“每个人都带来独特之处”，引出发现孩子才能的内容。

topicClues: a hobby that can be shared

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Hoping to find a hobby that can be shared by both the little ones and adults?
contextEvidence.afterQuote: You may know the “feel-good” emotions that come with helping others

mechanismSignals.relation: 空前“把家人聚到一起、可共享的爱好”与选项 B 的“以家庭为单位做志愿”属同一话题场，正面回应两个问句。

mechanismSignals.targetText: bring your family together / shared by both the little ones and adults
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 B 的“family”与空前“family together、little ones and adults”形成家庭话题场对齐。

mechanismSignals.targetText: a way to bring your family together
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 B 的“the thing you need”回指空前问句中“你正在寻找的方式”，构成问—答呼应。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前两个问句在问“有没有能让全家共享的活动”，选项 B“以家庭为单位做志愿也许正是你需要的”直接给出答案，并自然引出后文的志愿好处。

matchedClues.contextSide: bring your family together / shared by both the little ones and adults
matchedClues.relation: 都指向适合全家共同参与的活动，话题完全一致。

matchedClues.contextSide: Are you looking for a way
matchedClues.optionSide: may be just the thing you need
matchedClues.relation: 问句问“是否在找一种方式”，选项以“正是你需要的”作答。

keyDistractors.reason: G 也讲志愿的好处，但它强调“让你有能力感、把握每一天”，没有回应空前的“家庭共享活动”这一核心问句，不如 B 切题。

q-2025-ii-036.teachingNote: 段首一问一答型空格，先抓问句问的是什么，再选能直接作答并衔接下文的句子。

topicClues: feel like you have more time
giving your time to community causes
makes you feel like you have more of it

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: giving your time to community causes actually makes you feel like you have more of it.

mechanismSignals.signalText: makes you feel like you have more of it
mechanismSignals.targetText: makes you feel capable and inspires you to make the most of each day
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前讲志愿“让你觉得拥有更多（时间）”，选项 G 的“让你感到有能力、充分利用每一天”延续这种积极的自我感受话题场。

mechanismSignals.signalText: make the most of each day
mechanismSignals.targetText: have more of it / more time
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 G 的“充分利用每一天”与本段“感觉时间更多”主题呼应，是对该收益的升华总结。

mechanismSignals.targetText: makes you feel like you have more of it
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 G 的“makes you feel”与空前“makes you feel like”句式平行衔接，承接同一“感受”主语链。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段讲志愿让人“觉得时间更多”，段末空需要一句积极总结；选项 G“让你感到有能力并激励你充分利用每一天”正好把这种心理收益升华收束。

matchedClues.contextSide: makes you feel like you have more of it
matchedClues.optionSide: inspires you to make the most of each day
matchedClues.relation: 都在描述志愿带来的正向时间/自我效能感受。

keyDistractors.reason: A“帮助社区降低抑郁率”虽是好处，但与本段“时间/能力感”话题不符，属心理健康另一维度。

q-2025-ii-037.teachingNote: 段末总结空要顺着本段的核心收益往“升华”方向选，看哪句与本段感受词同场且语气一致。

topicClues: better memory and maintained overall health
adding physical activity into their lives

contextEvidence.afterQuote: Washington University found that adults 55 and older who volunteered had better memory and maintained overall health longer than others their age.

mechanismSignals.relation: 空后聚焦“55岁及以上成年人”，与选项 E 的“For adults”指向同一人群，主题句对应。
空后“保持整体健康、增加身体活动”与选项 E 的“身体健康益处”属同一健康话题场。

mechanismSignals.targetText: better memory / maintained overall health / physical activity
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 E 的“身体健康益处”概括空后记忆、整体健康、身体活动等具体表现，是该段主题句。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段以华盛顿大学对55岁以上成年人的研究为例，讲志愿带来的身体健康好处；空在段首作主题句，选项 E“对成年人而言，志愿能带来显著的身体健康益处”正好统领全段。

matchedClues.contextSide: maintained overall health / adding physical activity
matchedClues.relation: 下文细节正是身体健康益处的具体例证。

keyDistractors.reason: A 讲“降低抑郁率”属心理健康，与本段强调记忆、身体活动等生理健康不匹配。

q-2025-ii-038.teachingNote: 段首主题句空要找能被下文细节全面例证、且人群与话题都对应的概括句。

contextEvidence.afterQuote: Volunteering during teenage years has been linked to some major positive effects such as improved grades and increased self-confidence.

mechanismSignals.relation: 空后聚焦“青少年期的志愿”，与选项 C 的“kids and teenagers”人群对应，构成该段小标题主题。
空后“在未来岁月里持续影响”与选项 C 的“lifelong effect（终身影响）”同义呼应。

mechanismSignals.signalText: lifelong effect on kids and teenagers
mechanismSignals.targetText: improved grades / self-confidence / in the years to come
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 C 的“对孩子和青少年的终身影响”概括下文成绩、自信等不止短期、延续多年的效果。

optionFit.fitSummary: 该段讲青少年期做志愿带来的成绩提升、自信增强等不止短期、延续到未来的影响；空为缺失的小标题，选项 C“志愿对孩子和青少年有终身影响”恰好概括。

matchedClues.contextSide: These effects aren’t just short-term / in the years to come
matchedClues.relation: 下文强调长期、延续多年，正是“终身影响”。

keyDistractors.reason: F 讲“发现孩子的才能”虽涉及 kid，但只是单点惊喜，不能概括本段“成绩、自信、长期影响”的整体主题。

q-2025-ii-039.teachingNote: 小标题空要选能覆盖全段要点（人群+影响范围）的概括句，注意“lifelong”对应“in the years to come”。

topicClues: Everyone brings something unique to the table
connect with each other in a new way
tasks for every age and ability
all your children can feel proud

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Families who volunteer together have the unique experience of working toward a common goal.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Everyone brings something unique to the table and can connect with each other in a new way.

mechanismSignals.targetText: your kid has a talent you didn’t know about
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后“每个人都带来独特之处”与选项 F 的“发现孩子有你不知道的才能”属“发现各自特长”话题场，且 F 是其中一个具体例子。

mechanismSignals.signalText: all your children can feel proud
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后“所有孩子都能为自己的工作自豪”与选项 F 聚焦孩子（kid）的话题一致。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Everyone brings something unique / all your children
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 F 把“家人各展所长”这一抽象点落到“发现孩子的才能”这一具体惊喜上。
选项 F 的“your kid”与空后“all your children”指代同一对象——参与志愿的孩子，构成指称衔接。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段讲全家共做志愿能朝共同目标努力、各展所长；空前后都在说“每个人带来独特之处、孩子能感到自豪”，选项 F“你甚至会发现孩子有以前不知道的才能”正是这一点的具体延展。

matchedClues.contextSide: Everyone brings something unique to the table
matchedClues.optionSide: your kid has a talent you didn’t know about before
matchedClues.relation: 都讲在共同志愿中发现各人独特之处。

matchedClues.contextSide: all your children can feel proud of their work

keyDistractors.reason: G 讲“让你有能力感、把握每天”，与本段“家人共事、各展所长”话题不贴合，缺少对孩子才能这一具体延展的呼应。

q-2025-ii-040.teachingNote: 段中承接空要顺着前后句的话题场（此处“各展所长/孩子”）选具体延展句，并核对指称词与上下文一致。
